layers.name: Full person with Kangshifu iced tea jersey
layers.description: Extract the entire person as one single transparent layer, including his full face, arms, complete orange/yellow sleeveless jersey, all printed content on the jersey: Chinese text 康师傅, 冰红茶, ICE TEA print, all other original lettering, fruit imagery, all jersey folds and original colors. Do not separate any advertising elements from the jersey, do not include the plain blue background or the small white watermark in the lower right corner.
